svg.metadata: Based on Beads panel artwork by Emilie Gillet, from pichenettes/eurorack f4cfa7697095a28d292bff758beb51deb49b5a86 (https://github.com/pichenettes/eurorack/tree/f4cfa7697095a28d292bff758beb51deb49b5a86/beads/hardware_design/panel). Hardware artwork: CC BY-SA 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/). Adapted for VCV Rack: cut guides removed, grey background added, lowercase title glyphs reused from Clouds, numeral 2 from Plaits, footer removed, dimensions normalized. No endorsement by Mutable Instruments is implied.
